Hero.title: Hello, world! I'm Samuel!
Hero.intro: A Web and AI Application Developer, I switched careers into web development before going on to Le Wagon's Data Science & AI Bootcamp.
Hero.search: I'm mainly looking for a work-study position (master's level) or a permanent job in Data Science, more specifically in Data Engineering or MLOps, around Saint-Nazaire and Nantes (France), on site, hybrid or remote.

About.title: About me
About.intro1: Originally trained in industrial and then biomedical maintenance, and after working in many other jobs, I chose to retrain in web development, then moved on to Data Science and artificial intelligence.
About.intro2: In this section you'll find the skills I picked up during my career change and professional path, as well as my experience in development and data.
